title: The Ivory Gate — Vue & Reception Hall

settings.headline:
The day you'll relive forever,
held in the perfect room.
settings.copy: The Ivory Gate is an intimate wedding venue and reception hall — a light-filled barn of glass, oak, and gardens where your vows get the space they deserve.

trust_list.text: One all-inclusive venue, ceremony to send-off
Light-filled glass barn for up to 140 guests

stats.label: Weddings hosted since we opened in 2016
Space you never have to leave from vows to last dance

settings.title: Everything in one place,
settings.intro: We built this venue so you plan one wedding, not twenty vendors. Ceremony, cocktails, dinner, and dancing — all under one roof, all handled by one trusted team.

features.title: Glass-barn ceremony space
features.text: An oak-and-glass pavilion flooded with afternoon light, with a clear aisle that frames your vows against the gardens.

features.title: Grand reception hall
features.text: Seats 140 with a built-in dance floor, draped ceilings, and warm pendant lighting that shifts from daylight to candlelight.

features.title: In-house catering
features.text: A seasonal menu crafted by our own chefs, from passed hors d'oeuvres to a plated dinner — with tastings included in every package.

features.title: On-site coordination
features.text: A dedicated coordinator owns your timeline from rehearsal to send-off, so your family and friends can be guests, not staff.

features.title: Garden photo moments
features.text: Manicured lawns, an old stone arch, and a weeping willow give you a dozen backdrops within a two-minute walk of the hall.

features.title: Getting-ready suites
features.text: Two light-filled bridal and groom suites with mirrors, refreshments, and enough space for your whole party to gather before the aisle.

settings.title: Three ways to
settings.intro: Every package includes the venue, catering, and a coordinator. Choose the level of polish that fits your vision — we'll handle the rest.

design.title: Garden ceremony package
design.text: The glass pavilion, ceremony styling, an officiant, and sparkling-wine toast — for intimate vows of up to 60 guests.

design.title: Intimate dinner
design.text: A plated three-course dinner for your closest circle in the smaller oak room, with candlelight and garden views.

build.title: Full reception package
build.text: The grand hall, in-house catering, bar service, dance floor, and day-of coordination — the complete celebration for up to 140.

build.title: Flowers & styling
build.text: Our floral team builds the centerpieces, aisle décor, and arch arrangement to match your palette exactly.

launch.title: Weekend wedding
launch.text: Take over the whole estate Friday to Sunday — rehearsal dinner, ceremony, reception, and a farewell brunch, all yours.

launch.title: Multi-day guest experience
launch.text: On-site cottage stays for your party, lawn games, and a guided garden walk the morning after for lingering guests.

settings.title: From first tour to

steps.title: Tour
steps.text: Walk the gardens, stand in the glass pavilion, and picture your day. We'll answer every question — no pressure, no scripts.

steps.title: Book
steps.text: Reserve your date with a small deposit. Your coordinator and a tasting are scheduled, and the room is yours.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Choose your menu, florals, and timeline. We guide you through each choice and keep everything on track.

steps.title: Celebrate
steps.text: Show up and enjoy it. Our team runs the entire day seamlessly, so you're never pulled away from your people or your moment.

settings.note: Most couples book within two weeks of their first tour. Dates for peak season fill six to ten months ahead — reach out early to hold yours.

settings.title: The day we
settings.intro: What our couples say long after the last dance.

reviews.quote: We planned everything long-distance and our coordinator handled it all. On the day, we didn't lift a finger — we just got married in the most beautiful room I've ever stood in.
reviews.author: Amelia & James

reviews.quote: The tasting alone sold us. Our guests still talk about the dinner, and the way the hall looked at candlelight made me cry before the speeches even started.
reviews.author: Priya & Daniel

reviews.quote: One space for everything meant our 90-year-old grandmother never had to drive between venues. Everyone was together all day, and that was the whole point.
reviews.author: Rosa & Tom

settings.title: Come see the Ivory Gate
settings.intro: Book a private tour, ask about open dates, or start planning your celebration. We'll take it from there — gently.
